description: Two open-access RAG benchmark papers not present in earlier benchmark manifests, frozen before retrieval diagnostics.
reclassification_reason: The first frozen Hybrid diagnostic hit both target documents, all marked pages, and all explicit table numbers, but only 7/12 cases had complete required-fact coverage at @50 (macro 0.764, micro 0.763). Several failures are surface-order mismatches between extracted PDF evidence and the frozen fact strings, so this set is retained as a development regression rather than a confirmation set.
freeze_policy: Freeze documents, hashes, cases, gold facts, and retrieval configuration before any H12 retrieval or generation diagnostic. Any implementation or prompt change motivated by H12 reclassifies this set as development-regression.
